integrity: All equalities and limits are derived analytically in RESULT.md; standalone code supplies finite symbolic and numerical corroboration, not a proof for all parameters. The motivating reference was first made public on 2021-03-26; this date is not a claim about publication of the new theorem.
scientific_limitations: The classification assumes fixed integer ambient dimension d>=3 and pairwise disjoint signed-axis caps with threshold at least 1/sqrt(2). It analyzes pure degrees one and two with continuous noiseless spherical restriction, not their cumulative span or finite randomized sampling. The result is not asserted historically first without independent comparison.
title: Perfect linear isotropy and sharp quadratic instability on disjoint coordinate caps
